Explanation:  
The Ground Truth Answer states that Bill Clinton was president beginning in 1993, which is the same year Mary Elizabeth Butt (wife of Howard Edward Butt Sr.) passed away. The Predicted Answer states that Bill Clinton was president when Mary Elizabeth Butt died on October 6, 1993. The Predicted Answer provides even more detail, explicitly linking Bill Clinton's presidency with the date of death. Therefore, the substance and vital facts of the Ground Truth Answer—Bill Clinton was president when Mary Elizabeth Butt died in 1993—are clearly present in the Predicted Answer.

Decision: TRUE
